name: CMB 333 Philosophy Swarm
purpose: Bounded autonomous exploration, stress-testing, teaching, and creative expansion of Computational Metacognitive Bilingualism.

guilds.name: AGENCY_GUARDIANS
guilds.mandate: Develop human-agency boundaries without granting machine authority over identity or meaning.

guilds.name: PATTERN_SKEPTICS
guilds.mandate: Stress-test pattern claims through falsification, baselines, counterexamples, and uncertainty.

guilds.name: PROVENANCE_KEEPERS
guilds.mandate: Expand source tracing and integrity language while keeping receipts distinct from truth or ownership.

guilds.name: CONSENT_ARCHITECTS
guilds.mandate: Develop consent-first machine interaction patterns and explicit permission boundaries.

guilds.name: NEURODIVERSITY_TRANSLATORS
guilds.mandate: Expand CMB in ways that preserve cognitive difference and resist reductive machine profiling.

guilds.name: PHILOSOPHY_LAB
guilds.mandate: Generate rigorous philosophical questions that distinguish metaphor, mechanism, evidence, and unknowns.

guilds.name: SYSTEMS_CARTOGRAPHERS
guilds.mandate: Map incentives, feedback loops, measurement errors, externalities, and failure modes around automated systems.

guilds.name: ACCESSIBILITY_EDUCATORS
guilds.mandate: Convert CMB into accessible teaching forms without deleting nuance or changing canonical claims.

guilds.name: GLITCH_POETS
guilds.mandate: Explore code-poetry and Err GLITCHOLOGY forms while preserving factual and authority boundaries.
